Raw Makhana types

4 SUTTA
Standard / Economy grade
12.7–15.8 mm
Suitable for everyday snacking, bulk supply and value-oriented retail.

5 SUTTA
Premium retail grade
15.8–19 mm
Suitable for branded snack packs, flavoured makhana and premium retail.

6 SUTTA
Jumbo / Premium grade
19–22.2 mm
Suitable for premium exports, gourmet snack brands and luxury retail.

Indicative size ranges; actual supplier grading specifications may vary.

Comparison at a glance

| Parameter | 4 Sutta | 5 Sutta | 6 Sutta |
|---|---|---|---|
| Size | Smaller | Larger | Largest |
| Appearance | Standard | Fuller | Jumbo |
| Market segment | Economy | Premium | Super-premium |
| Price | Relatively lower | Higher | Highest |
